note: Every gate finding gets a stable rule id, a default severity and status, and the assumption it rests on. A gate may emit a full Finding itself and override any of these; findings that are only dicts are wrapped with the entry below. status=estimate is capped at P1 by fluxpcb.findings.

severity_scale.P0: confirmed manufacturing failure; a board with one is not shippable
severity_scale.P1: confirmed problem that is tolerable to ship, or a strong signal; also the ceiling for any estimate
severity_scale.P2: advisory: worth fixing, does not block

spec_schema.assumption: the template's required keys are the whole contract for a spec

requirement_coverage.assumption: covered_by names map onto the gate list this build knows

bom_completeness.assumption: every footprint on the board comes from a BOM line

bom_lcsc_verified.assumption: the catalog snapshot is at most 7 days old and the part is buyable at that price

erc_zero.assumption: the ERC ran on the netlist that was exported from this schematic

netlist_topology.assumption: the netlist text is the authoritative connectivity

drc_zero.assumption: the DRC ran against the board's own rules (.kicad_pro beside it) and the report is bound to this board's bytes

impedance_si.assumption: IPC-2141 closed form on the declared stackup; the copper as routed is not measured

irdrop.assumption: a synthetic rail grid stands in for the copper; a geometry solve is dc_irdrop_geom

thermal.assumption: 2-D conduction on a synthetic grid, natural convection; no per-component package model

emc_precompliance.assumption: series-RL / parallel-decap network at the declared switching edges; no field solve

firmware_build.assumption: the toolchain on PATH is the one the firmware targets

firmware_spi_loopback.assumption: the loopback record was produced by this firmware build

placement_quality.assumption: regex geometry over the .kicad_pcb text; courtyards are read from the footprint, not recomputed

firmware_regression.assumption: the host compiler reproduces the target's integer behaviour

spice_functional.assumption: the testbench is representative of the load; component models are the vendor's

plane_integrity.assumption: zone presence and stitching read from the board text; fill is not measured here

dc_irdrop_geom.assumption: the copper of this board is the conductor; one rail at a time

dc_current_density.assumption: IPC-2221 current limit for 1 oz outer copper, no temperature derating

plane_cavity_resonance.assumption: rectangular cavity of the board outline with uniform er and a declared dielectric height

pdn_impedance_ac.assumption: lumped plane L/C and the decap plan in the spec; no plane EM extraction

return_path.assumption: analytic return-current concentration J(d)=I/(pi*h)/(1+(d/h)^2), no slot geometry

em_field_analysis.assumption: the openEMS case generated here is the geometry of interest and the mesh resolves the trace

thermal_cfd.assumption: a CFD case must run for a verdict; the solver being installed is not a verdict

routing_completeness.assumption: KiCad's own ratsnest after a zone refill is the connectivity truth

fabrication_netlist.assumption: IPC-D-356 off the board and the schematic netlist describe the same design

em_susceptibility.assumption: loop area from the polyline, 1/d^2 coupling, no current spectrum; openEMS upgrades this to a field solve

pre_route_estimate.assumption: capacity, impedance and net classes before copper exists; nothing here is a measurement

CAPACITY.channel.title: Traces per channel between ball rings

PHYS.j_density.source: copper field solve J = sigma|grad V|, 2 mm-smoothed max

PHYS.via_current.source: via link in the copper graph

RETURN.availability.source: image-current availability on the filled pour
